name: Fit DTI
summary: Fits the diffusion tensor to DWI within a brain mask with DIPY (dipy_fit_dti, weighted least squares) and outputs FA, MD, RD, AD and other DTI maps.
description: Runs dipy_fit_dti (DIPY 1.1.1) on a DWI with its bvals, bvecs and a brain mask. Use it to compute standard DTI scalar maps for tract profiling or group analyses. Needs a brain mask aligned to the DWI; b0_threshold sets which volumes count as b=0.

inputs.description: DWI image with bvals and bvecs.
Brain mask in the same space as the DWI; the tensor is fitted only inside it.

outputs.description: DTI maps written by dipy_fit_dti (tensor, FA, MD, RD, AD, colour FA and related maps).

parameters.description: Threshold used to find b=0 directions
Threshold used to check that norm(bvec) = 1 +/- bvecs_tolb-vectors are unit vectors

citations.text: Garyfallidis E, et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Front Neuroinform 8:8 (2014).
Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
